<function name="LocalToWorld" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
A convenience function around LocalToWorld-related functions.

<note>If <page>Entity:EntIndex</page> returns `0`, the function will return the passed `lpos`.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<file line="76-L95">lua/includes/extensions/util.lua</file>

		<arg name="bone" type="number" default="0">
Actually to be treated as the number corresponding to a specific <page>PhysObj</page> of the entity.

If that specific physics object is valid, then <page>PhysObj:LocalToWorld</page> is used.

Otherwise, <page>Entity:LocalToWorld</page>.
</arg>
